$comment: HZ-133: the contract for domain/personas.json. Validated by domain/validate.mjs — the same dependency-free Draft-07 subset validator the other domain/ schemas use, so only the keywords listed in its KEYWORDS set are honoured (no `pattern`, no schema-valued `additionalProperties`). Rules the subset cannot express — the id shape ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$ on agents and persona ids, unique agents, ids unique WITHIN their agent, `default` being one of its own agent's personas, `primaryAgent` naming a declared agent, and every legacyIds value and personaProviders key naming a live <agent>.<persona> pair — are asserted at LOAD time by the bindings themselves: see assertPersonasShape() in domain/js/personas.js and _validate_source() in domain/py/personas.py, which domain/fixtures/personas-cases.json drives from both sides so the two cannot drift. `additionalProperties: false` at every object level is what keeps presentation (labels, initials, colours) structurally out of this file rather than out by convention.
title: Horizon specialist personas: ids, agent membership, defaults and persona-to-provider

primaryAgent.$comment: The agent whose persona the PM proposes at intake and the board/tracker show as an item's primary specialization. Must name a declared agent — asserted at load time.

agents.$comment: ARRAY ORDER IS THE ORDER. It is the picker's group order and the farm's provider_for() scan order, so it is visible behaviour. Each persona id is unique only WITHIN its agent (HZ-125): `python` under eng and a future `python` under qa are different personas.

agent.$comment: A persona-agent key (lower-case), not a domain/steps.json agent name. The role file is DERIVED as farm/roles/personas/<agent>_<persona>.md, so there is no `file` field.

default.$comment: The persona an item gets for this agent when it carries none, or carries one that does not belong to this agent. Must be one of this entry's `personas` — asserted at load time.

personas.$comment: ARRAY ORDER IS THE ORDER the picker lists them in.

legacyIds.$comment: Flat pre-HZ-125 work_item.persona value -> the namespaced "<agent>.<persona>" it now means. Read-only compatibility for old rows, never written. Each value must name a declared pair — asserted at load time.

personaProviders.$comment: Namespaced "<agent>.<persona>" -> the farm provider that persona forces. Ships EMPTY (HZ-121): no shipped persona forces a provider. Keys must name a declared pair — asserted at load time.
